title: Ocean Edge Villa | Coastal unit with ocean views
description: Ocean Edge Villa | Coastal unit with ocean viewsThe spaceOcean Edge Villa offers the perfect retreat to relax and soak in the beauty of our island. This charming 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment is located in Rincón, a laid-back coastal town renowned for its world-class surfing, stunning sunsets, beautiful beaches, and vibrant arts and culinary scene. Ocean Edge Villa offers beautiful ocean views and is a short 5-minute ride to the beach. It features a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable living area with flat-screen TV, and a private balcony overlooking the water. The apartment comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests and has a washer and dryer for your convenience. LIVING AREAEnter Ocean Edge Villa and you are greeted by the living area with a cozy sofa and armchair, and a flat screen TV to enjoy your favorite shows. The living area has air conditioning to keep things nice and cool. Past the living area, you have a cozy balcony with two rocking chairs ideal to relax and enjoy the ocean views. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThere are two bedrooms at Ocean Edge Villa . The master bedroom has a king bed and the 2nd bedroom has a queen bed. Both bedrooms have closets, nightstands, blackout window treatments, and air conditioning. Th master bedroom has an flat screen TV.PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability. KITCHENOcean Edge Villa has a spacious and fully equipped kitchen that is completely equipped for an extended stay. The kitchen is features a fridge, freezer, microwave, stovetop, oven, coffee maker, dishwasher, and toaster. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGWe strongly recommend renting a car, as there are a multitude of activities within a 15-30-minute drive that you will not want to miss out on. Also, Uber is not readily available in the area, which is why it's important to have your own means of transportation.The villa includes one (1) assigned parking spot.LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at the Balneario de Rincon.Enjoy a beautiful sunset dinner at La Copa Llena.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon of surfing at Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle Boards.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergent Please note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 4 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

description: A unique experience for couples. Enjoy this beautiful private pool villa at Bohemian Suites. De no seguir las normas de alquiler su reserva podría ser cancelada.The internet service is offered as a courtesy , according to the availability of the provider. We take no responsibility if the provider has problems in the area.Our facilities are connected and depend exclusively on public service utilities of electricity and water service of Puerto Rico power company and water co, AAA, AEE & LUMA. Reservations are confirmed in acknowledgement that the interruption of these services caused by the provider will not result in the termination of the reservation or any type of refunds.Other this to note:We spray for bugs with a professional on a regularly basis but please have in mind that the suite is in a forest area and the space is created in a inside/outside space which still might have bugs in a natural forest setting.Important: RESERVATIONS IN JUNE IN PUERTO RICO THERES A NATURAL PHENOMENON. We left all the lights off because the first couple of hard rains in May and June every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. The first couple of hard rains in May every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. THIS HAPPENS EVERYWHERE IN PUERTO RICO, you can be in a restaurant, the airbnb or any place in the island.There’s no way to exterminate them as they are in almost every three in Puerto Rico and attracted by light. They are harmless but a pain to clean.They fly during the night of a very hard rain, it is VERY IMPORTANT that you leave all the LIGHTS OFF inside the apartment when you leave or while you are in there because these flying termites will come in. It's very hard to predict the date but I know it's around this time of the year.Please TURN OFF ALL the light when expected to come back at night or when leaving at night or if you are in the apartment and see flying bugs do so as well. title: Modern 2BR/2BA unit in Rincón
description: Modern 2BR/2BA unit in Rincón with one king and one queen bed, a sleek open kitchen, and bright living area overlooking the pool and hot tub. Perfect for a couple or small family and can be rented together with the 4BR home on the property to host larger groups just steps from the beach and downtown.The spaceThis newly remodeled 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom designer unit in Rincón gives you boutique‑hotel style with the comfort of home. Thoughtful finishes, warm wood tones, and floor‑to‑ceiling light make the space feel calm and airy, while access to the shared pool, hot tub, and outdoor kitchen brings full resort vibes just steps from your door.Located in Rincón’s surf zone, you’re a short walk from the beach and close to downtown restaurants, cafés, bars, surf shops, grocery stores, and pharmacies. It’s the perfect base for a couple’s escape, a small family, or friends who want to be near the action but still have a quiet, high‑end place to land.The spaceWalk into an open‑plan kitchen, dining, and living area designed for relaxing and hanging out. The kitchen features modern appliances, a large island with seating, and plenty of counter space for cooking, mixing drinks, or spreading out snacks after the beach. The dining table seats everyone comfortably, and the living area is set up for long conversations, movie nights, or working remotely with great natural light.Big windows frame views over the pool, hot tub, and tropical landscaping, so even when you’re inside you still feel connected to the outdoor space. Neutral tones and soft textures make the whole unit feel like a modern coastal hotel suite.Sleeping arrangementsBedroom 1: King bed with stylish furnishings, quality linens, and space to unpack and unwindBedroom 2: Queen bed in a bright, comfortable room ideal for another couple or older kidsWith one king and one queen, the unit sleeps up to 4 guests in real beds, making it perfect for a couple plus kids, two couples traveling together, or a small surf crew. Each bedroom is close to its own bathroom, so mornings and evenings flow easily.BathroomsTwo modern bathrooms feature clean lines, tiled showers, and contemporary fixtures. The layout makes it easy for guests to get ready at the same time, and the finishes keep the space feeling fresh and upscale.Outdoor livingStep outside and you’re just steps from a beautiful pool and hot tub shared with the main house. Loungers around the pool invite long, lazy afternoons in the sun, and the outdoor kitchen area is ideal for grilling, enjoying sunset dinners, or staying out late without ever leaving the property.The setting is quiet and private, but you’re still close enough to feel the energy of Rincón—sunsets, surf, and night‑life are all within easy reach.LocationYou’re in one of Rincón’s most convenient zones: a short walk to the beach and a quick drive or comfortable stroll to downtown. Within minutes you’ll find:Multiple surf breaks and swimming beachesCoffee shops, bakeries, and casual eateriesFull‑service restaurants and barsGrocery stores, pharmacies, and convenience shopsWhether you’re here for surf, sunsets, or a relaxed family vacation, you’re close to everything while tucked into a stylish, peaceful retreat.Renting with the 4BR homeThis unit sits on the same property as a separate 4 bedroom / 3.5 bathroom resort‑style home. When available, you can book both spaces together to sleep larger groups or multi‑generation families while keeping everyone just a few steps apart.Together, the two units create a flexible setup for:Two families traveling togetherCouples plus extended familyLarger surf or adventure groups who want shared outdoor space but individual privacyBook the 2BR on its own for a chic, comfortable stay, or combine it with the 4BR to turn the entire property into your private Rincón compound.link to other listing https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1745308994043058471?unique_share_id=ad53c50f-298d-4a06-8b8f-d4c9e656c096&viralityEntryPoint=1&s=76This unit has 7ft ceilingsoutdoor kitchen, hot tub, pool and firepit is a shared common space

description: Steps from Rincon's plaza, top-rated restaurants, craft brewery, farmers market & Thursday art walk. Beach in 10 min on foot.Private studio with its own entrance, A/C, bathroom & kitchenette in the heart of downtown Rincon. Part of a shared building, but completely private. Perfect for surfers, solo travelers & couples wanting Rincon's best location without the price tag. Full bed. High-speed WiFi. Smart TV. Self check-in. Pets welcome for a fee. Free street parking.The spaceAbove the Plaza 3 is a private studio tucked at the back of the property — your own quiet corner of downtown Rincon with a separate entrance so you come and go completely on your own schedule.Inside you will find a full bed with quality linens, pillows, and towels provided. The kitchenette is equipped with a microwave, coffee maker, toaster, sink, dinnerware, cookware, and everything you need to prepare a meal. A private bathroom, individual A/C unit, flat-screen Smart TV, and high-speed WiFi complete the space.One thing to be upfront about: an interior door connects the studio to the rest of the building. It remains closed during your stay for full privacy. ATP3 is part of a shared property — think of it as a private studio apartment within a small building rather than a fully standalone unit.Rincon's plaza, top-rated restaurants, craft brewery, bakery, and weekly art walk are all a two-minute walk from your door. The beach is ten minutes on foot.Everything you need is here. Everything else is a short walk away.Guest accessAbove the Plaza 3 is entirely yours — no shared spaces, no other guests, no interruptions. The private studio is your own retreat from the moment you check in to the moment you check out.Make yourself at home. Cook in the kitchenette, unwind with the A/C on full blast, and enjoy the privacy of your own entrance. This is your space to settle into Rincon's rhythm at your own pace.During your stayWe respect your space and let you settle in on your own terms — but we're always just a message away when you need us.Beyond the studio, we're happy to help make your Rincon experience unforgettable. Through our local network we can point you toward the best activities, hidden gems, and trusted providers the area has to offer — the kind of insider knowledge that doesn't show up on a Google search.We can also arrange private transportation to and from Aguadilla, San Juan, and Ponce airports — just reach out before your trip and we'll take care of the details.Other things to noteA note on noise: the house sits on Rincon's main road, so you may occasionally hear passing traffic. In our experience guests find it easy to tune out — but we'd rather you know upfront than be surprised. The covered terrace in the back is your quiet escape when you want it.What you won't hear is Plaza noise. Despite being two minutes away on foot, the house sits just far enough from the action that evenings stay peaceful — the best of both worlds.

description: Find your paradise at this villa just up the road from the famous Steps Beach and right above the number one breakfast spot with a view in Rincon, The English Rose. Casa Montaña is the perfect home for families, friends and large groups.Check us out on @casamontanarinconThe spaceCasa Montaña Nestled in the heart of Pineapple Hill, on the 413 Interior Road, looking west over the Caribbean Sea, is La Casa Montaña. A five bedroom, three story home with four separate apartments, two full kitchens, pool and amazing ocean views. This home offers a large house feel with separate living spaces for privacy when you are with a large group. The top floor patio is the gathering place for the house, boasting stunning west facing sunset views of the Caribbean Sea. The patio has covered and open air areas, hammocks, a large wooden picnic table and couches to lounge on. The Master bedroom of the house is on this floor, it has a very comfortable pillow top king mattress, large closet and views of the valley and ocean. The bathroom is between the kitchen and the bedroom with views of the jungle below. The large fully equipped kitchen has a wonderful ocean view looking out of the front door and windows onto the patio. Off of the kitchen there is a charming floating balcony for you to enjoy your morning coffee while watching the sun rise over the mountains of Moca or to watch the moon rise in the evening with a glass of wine!Walking down the stairs from the top floor is the two bedroom apartment (queen size/king size beds) complete with full kitchen, open dining and living room, laundry room and a large jack and jill bathroom. Also, on this level is the salt water pool along with a beautiful pergola over looking the valley below. The pool is surrounded by lush tropical plants making it private. Continuing on, down the stairs from the pool or from the two bedroom apartment, is the Pool Room, this bedroom is all windows that look out onto lush vegetation. It has a very comfortable queen size bed, bathroom and sitting area. Now, walking around the bottom of the house from the Pool Room is the Blue Room, this can be accessed from the driveway side of the house as well. The Blue Room is a spacious bedroom with a luxurious pillow top king, a large bathroom and outdoor living area for reading books or relaxing.Guest accessThe whole house.Other things to noteCasa Montaña is a very private place. However, there are neighbors that live full time in the area. We ask that you please be respectful with noise after 10PM. No loud karaoke, or sound systems. We want you to enjoy yourselves but not at the expense of our neighbors peace. We really appreciate your consideration! Casa Montaña is on top of a mountain.We have a Pack N Play for children, if needed. As well as two blow up mattresses for extra sleeping space. We have many surfboards hanging on the walls. Those surfboards are NOT TO BE TOUCHED OR USED. If you want to rent a surfboard you can go to the local surf shop. Let us know if you are looking for a surf coach or a personal Chef. We know the best guys in town:)It is understood that many flights get in late (or early in the morning) from Aguadilla. Check in time is 3PM. Guests are welcome to check in at any time they arrive after 3PM on their check-in day. Please be aware that if your flight gets in at 1AM and you want to check in at 2-3AM, you will need to book the night prior to reserve the room. You will be able to let yourself in with a keypad.

description: Upon entering The Villas at Horned Dorset, you'll be embraced by lush gardens, Mediterranean design, and an infinity pool seamlessly blending with the ocean. The serene ambiance ensures a tranquil stay, while the central location offers easy access to Rincon's town, beaches, restaurants, bars, and supermarkets—providing a diverse vacation experience, whether you prefer relaxation within the villa or lively exploration in Rincon and nearby towns.The spaceThe Villas at Horned Dorset are next to the hotel Horned Dorset Primavera (which is closed as of this writing) and they run completely separate. Villa Oceana consists of two spacious floors with tropical colonial decoration. On the first floor you will find; a kitchenette (with mini fridge, microwave, toaster oven, toaster, coffee maker, espresso machine, dishes, cups, glasses, wine glasses and silverware), a dining table for four people, a working desk, a sofa bed and a full bathroom. Enjoy the backyard, surrounded by lush foliage. Unwind by the private plunge pool, equipped with two lounge chairs, an umbrella, and a bar table with two stools. Immerse yourself in the soothing sounds of crashing waves, singing birds and the enchanting chorus of coquis at night. Beneath a majestic mango tree, witness the night sky adorned with sparkling stars.On the second floor is the master bedroom with a king size bed and en-suite bathroom with a free standing tub and separate shower all covered in Carrara marble. There is also a space to sit and relax, read a book or listen to music.There are 2 beach chairs, a small cooler and beach towels available for guests to use. Please wash (rinse with water) the beach chairs and cooler after using them so that future guests can also enjoy them. There is a water nozzle in the backyard. There is Wi-Fi and a smart TV with plenty of channels through the Samsung TV Plus App. The main applications are already downloaded to watch movies or stream tv series.There is a generator that covers the entire complex in case of a power failure.Guest accessGuests will be able to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of the complex and use the community infinity pool overlooking the sea. Access to beach depends on the season of the year and weather conditions. There is free parking on premises.Other things to noteCleaning of plunge pool is every Thursday morning.

description: Indulge in serene living in our newly-renovated, spacious 2BR apartment perched in the breezy hills of Rincon. As we are on an island, utilities such as electricity, water, and Wi-Fi can occasionally be interrupted without notice. The property is equipped with a backup generator; however, generators require fuel, and during extended outages we are dependent on fuel delivery availability, just like everyone else on the island. Unlike the mainland, utility disruptions here may take several days to resolve. If you require reliable power and/or internet access during your stay, we strongly recommend bringing your own mobile hotspot, and power pack as uninterrupted service cannot be guaranteed.

Within a 5-minute walk you will be in the best restaurants and bars. Enjoy the The Art Walk on Thursday evenings with live music, local venders selling art, jewelry, paintings, and so much more. Rincón also offers beautiful beaches for relaxing or surfing, along with gorgeous sunsets due the location on the west coast of the island.The spaceThe home spaces include two bedrooms, one bathroom, living room and dining area, cozy front balcony, back patio space with two hammocks and the washer/dryer, and garage area containing an outdoor shower and room to park your vehicle if you like. This property is well equipped for all you will need to have a spectacular time in Rincón. The first bedroom has a full-size bed, the second bedroom contains a bunkbed with two twin-size beds. The kitchen is fully equipped with refrigerator, stove, microwave, coffee-maker, dishwasher, dishes and silverware, and cooking basics.Parking: The property can accommodate two vehicles. Typically, one vehicle can park in driveway, outside of the garage, or in the garage if you prefer. A second vehicle can be parallel-parked on the street front of the house, or in the driveway outside of the garage if there is a vehicleGuest access· Wifi · Smart TV· A/C unit in both bedrooms · Washer and dryer· Solar Panels + Tesla Battery Back-up· Outdoor shower· Security Cameras· Keyless Entry (Smart Locks) · Blow-dryer· Coffee-maker· Panini-press/toaster· Dishwasher· No pets allowedOther things to noteIMPORTANT - Solar Power back-up system: In the event the grid (Luma) power goes out, we will notify you immediately. If the grid power goes out, the Tesla battery and/or real-time solar energy (only during the day, and if it is sunny) will automatically provide back-up power to the home. However, you will not be able to run the AC’s throughout the night, and you should also refrain from cooking on the stove or using hot water, as all of those systems utilize a high amount of electric energy and will quickly drain the battery. The objective of the back-up system is to ensure that your basic needs are always covered, which include the refrigerator, lights, and fans.
